modules.name: Neighbours
modules.description: Lets a resident see limited details of flats on the same floor of their building.

requirements.title: Show same-floor neighbours list
requirements.description: When a resident opens Neighbours, the system shows only flats on the same floor of the same building, with flat number, main person's name and occupation.

requirements.title: Update list when main person changes
requirements.description: When the main person of a flat changes (owner change or new tenant), the neighbours list updates at once.

rules.title: Restrict neighbour list to same floor and building
rules.description: Only flats on the same floor of the same building as the resident may be shown.

rules.title: Hide private details of neighbours
rules.description: Phone, email, family, and owner or tenant status are never shown in the neighbours list.

rules.title: Hide vacant or unregistered flats
rules.description: A flat that is vacant or not registered is not shown in the neighbours list.

rules.title: Respect "Show me to neighbours" setting
rules.description: If the main person turned off "Show me to neighbours", the flat is shown as flat number only.
